title: Marryandbride
description: A bridal knitwear boutique: white paper, warm near-black ink, a warm grey for prices and captions and one charcoal button. A refined text serif (Newsreader, display optical size, light) for headings and long story lines over DM Sans for uppercase tracked labels; square corners, no shadows, warm translucent hairlines.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a warm-black sibling with ivory ink
muted is the warm greige of photo placeholders; muted-foreground is the rgb(99,99,94) caption grey
primary is the charcoal of the one filled button; the announcement bar uses foreground
radius is 2px (only tiny UI is rounded); gutter 15px on phones, 17px from 1024px
type is fluid on the original; blocks use their own clamp() sizes on top of these tokens
name: marryandbride-theme
